dedupe_keys.name: zindi traffic jam mobiticket bus ticket sales on 14 routes into nairobi october 2017 to april 2018

description: Traffic Jam: Predicting People's Movement into Nairobi was a Zindi challenge (September 2018 to January 2019) in which Uber and Mobiticket asked for models of bus demand into Nairobi. Contents: historic ticket purchase records for 14 bus and shuttle routes into Nairobi from October 2017 to April 2018, with origin, scheduled departure time, purchase channel, vehicle type, vehicle capacity and assigned seat; the target is the number of seats sold per ride. Routes start in towns north-west of Nairobi towards Lake Victoria (such as Kisii, Migori, Homa Bay, Keroka and Rongo), take about 8 to 9 hours to the first stop and 2 to 3 more hours through Nairobi via Kawangware, Westlands and Afya Centre. Competitors could build their own traffic features from the Uber Movement platform. Producer: Mobiticket and Uber via Zindi. Coverage: 14 intercity routes into Nairobi, 2017 to 2018. Format and access: training archive, test questions and sample submission from Zindi after joining. Licence: the pages read do not state a data licence; use follows the competition rules. Caveats: ticket sales from one operator platform. Simulation uses: intercity bus demand modelling, effects of urban congestion on public transport, and scheduling. Related records: none in the catalogue for these routes.
